```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM main."rulings" r
JOIN main."cards" c ON r.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.setCode = 'ORI'
  AND (c.name = 'Kytheon, Hero of Akros // Gideon, Battle-Forged' OR c.faceName LIKE '%Kytheon%' OR c.faceName LIKE '%Gideon, Battle-Forged%')
  AND r.date >= '2015-06-01'
  AND r.date <= '2015-06-30'
```
